about: Hand-written test inputs, not pack data: a household problem in one plain sentence, as the reader's stage A writes it. Each lists the guide refs that would be a correct match.

questions.text: The kitchen sink drains very slowly and water stands in it
Soy sauce spilled on my white shirt
The toilet keeps running after I flush
The toilet is clogged and the water is rising
The smoke detector chirps every minute
A breaker tripped and half the kitchen has no power
The garbage disposal hums but does not turn
The washing machine shakes and bangs during the spin
The TV has sound but the screen is black
Red wine spilled on the living room carpet
There is a small hole in the drywall behind the door
The car battery is dead and the car will not start
A rock left a small chip in the windshield
The headlights look cloudy and yellow
Cockroaches come out in the kitchen at night
Black mold is growing on the shower caulk
My phone says the storage is almost full
The phone battery is swollen and the back is lifting
The GFCI outlet in the bathroom will not reset
The dryer takes forever to dry a load
The washer smells musty inside
The grout in the shower has turned black
The tire pressure light came on
The windshield wipers streak and squeak
Water drips from the bathroom faucet aerator and pressure is low
The brakes grind when I stop
I smell gas near the water heater and it will not heat
The window screen is torn
My white sneakers are dirty
The light switch in the hall is broken
